    • Client

      public Client(Integer id, String name, String username, String password, Boolean active, Boolean approved, String email, String pic, String type, String nif, String phoneNumber, String residence, String businessSector, String tier)
      Constructor that assigns attributes to a Client
      Parameters:
      id - Id of the client
      name - Name of the client
      username - Username of the client
      password - Password of the client
      active - If the client account is active and not banned
      approved - If the client account was approved after creation
      email - Email of the client
      pic - Picture of the client
      type - Equals the type of account in this case client
      nif - NIF of the client
      phoneNumber - Phone Number of the client
      residence - Residence of the client
      businessSector - Business Sector of the client
      tier - Tier of the client
